title: Microsoft Purview DLP: matched sender, recipient, subject and attachment conditions in Exchange Online alerts
summary: Hold: the auditing-default statement omits Microsoft's exception for unmanaged tenants using free enterprise trials, where auditing must be enabled manually. The feature details, licensing background and control paths are supported, but the assurance that rule actions do not change needs narrower wording.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes no change to mail evaluation or sender and recipient behaviour for this enhancement.
